p1: Do you enjoy learning new things?
你喜欢学习新事物吗？
What was your favourite subject at school?
你在学校最喜欢什么科目？
Do you prefer studying alone or with other people?
你喜欢独自学习还是和别人一起学习？

p2.title: Describe a teacher who had a positive influence on you.
p2.zh: 描述一位对你有积极影响的老师。
cues: when and where you studied with them
what they did that helped you
p2.explain: and explain why their influence was important to you.

p3: How can schools help students become more independent learners?
学校如何帮助学生成为更独立的学习者？
Is practical experience as valuable as classroom learning?
实践经验是否与课堂学习同样有价值？
Why do some adults find it difficult to return to education?
为什么一些成年人觉得重返校园很困难？

p1: What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
你最喜欢工作或学习的哪一点？
Would you prefer to work in a team or on your own?
你更喜欢团队工作还是独自工作？
What kind of work would you like to do in the future?
你将来想从事什么工作？

p2.title: Describe a useful skill you learned for work or study.
p2.zh: 描述一项对工作或学习有用的技能。
p2.explain: and explain how this skill helped you.

p3: What skills are becoming more important in the workplace?
哪些技能在职场上变得更重要？
How can employers help staff maintain a healthy work-life balance?
雇主如何帮助员工平衡工作与生活？
Should companies invest more in training existing employees?
企业是否应该更多投资于现有员工培训？

p1: Which digital device do you use most often?
你最常用哪种数字设备？
Do you ever take a break from using your phone?
你会暂时放下手机休息吗？
Has technology changed the way you study?
科技改变了你的学习方式吗？

p2.title: Describe a piece of technology that is useful in your daily life.
p2.zh: 描述一件对你日常生活有用的科技产品。
p2.explain: and explain how it has changed your daily routine.

p3: Has technology improved the quality of communication?
科技是否提升了沟通的质量？
Who should be responsible for protecting personal information online?
谁应负责保护网络上的个人信息？
Why might some people struggle to adapt to new technology?
为什么有些人难以适应新技术？

focus: 从具体行动谈到更大影响
p1: Do you try to save electricity at home?
你在家会注意节电吗？
Is there a park or green space near your home?
你家附近有公园或绿地吗？
What do you usually do with things you no longer need?
你通常怎样处理不再需要的东西？

p2.title: Describe a time when you did something to help the environment.
p2.zh: 描述一次你为保护环境做事的经历。
cues: where and when you did it
p2.explain: and explain how you felt about the experience.

p3: How can cities encourage people to use less energy?
城市如何鼓励人们减少能源消耗？
Should governments or individuals take greater responsibility for environmental protection?
政府和个人谁应承担更大的环保责任？
What makes it difficult for businesses to reduce waste?
是什么让企业难以减少废弃物？

p1: What do you do to stay healthy?
你会做什么来保持健康？
Do you prefer exercising indoors or outdoors?
你更喜欢室内还是户外运动？
Has your daily routine changed in recent years?
你的日常作息近年有变化吗？

p2.title: Describe a healthy habit you would like to develop.
p2.zh: 描述一个你想养成的健康习惯。
cues: why you want to develop it
what you would need to change
p2.explain: and explain what might help you keep this habit.

p3: Why do some people find it hard to change unhealthy habits?
为什么有些人难以改变不健康的习惯？
How can schools encourage children to lead healthier lives?
学校如何鼓励孩子过更健康的生活？
Should public health services focus more on prevention?
公共卫生服务是否应该更重视预防？

focus: 描述地点，比较不同选择
p1: What do you like about the area where you live?
你喜欢居住地区的哪些方面？
How do you usually travel around your city?
你通常在城市里怎样出行？
Would you like to live somewhere quieter?
你想住在更安静的地方吗？

p2.title: Describe a place in a city that you enjoy visiting.
p2.zh: 描述一个你喜欢去的城市地点。
p2.explain: and explain why you enjoy spending time there.

p3: What is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion?
什么方式能有效缓解交通拥堵？
How can cities become more suitable for families?
城市如何变得更适合家庭居住？
Should city centres give more space to pedestrians?
城市中心是否应该给行人更多空间？

p1: Do you prefer saving money or spending it?
你更喜欢存钱还是花钱？
Do you compare prices before buying something?
你购买东西前会比较价格吗？
Do you enjoy shopping online?
你喜欢网购吗？

p2.title: Describe something you bought that was worth the money.
p2.zh: 描述一件你认为买得很值的东西。
p2.explain: and explain why you think it was worth the money.

p3: Why do people sometimes buy things they do not need?
为什么人们有时会买不需要的东西？
How does advertising influence young consumers?
广告如何影响年轻消费者？
What can governments do to reduce income inequality?
政府能做些什么来缩小收入差距？

p1: How do you usually find out about the news?
你通常如何了解新闻？
Do you prefer reading news or watching it?
你更喜欢看文字新闻还是视频新闻？
What kinds of online content interest you?
什么类型的网络内容让你感兴趣？

p2.title: Describe a news story that attracted your attention.
p2.zh: 描述一则引起你注意的新闻。
cues: where you heard or read about it
what you did after learning about it
p2.explain: and explain why it interested you.

p3: How can people judge whether online information is reliable?
人们如何判断网络信息是否可靠？
Why do negative news stories often attract attention?
为什么负面新闻常常引起注意？
What responsibilities do people have when sharing news online?
人们在网络分享新闻时应承担什么责任？

focus: 用细节表现体验与差异
p1: What kinds of places do you like visiting on holiday?
假期你喜欢去什么地方？
Is there a local tradition that you particularly enjoy?
你特别喜欢哪项当地传统？
Do you prefer travelling alone or with other people?
你喜欢独自旅行还是结伴出游？

p2.title: Describe a traditional place or event you have experienced.
p2.zh: 描述一个你去过的传统场所或参与过的传统活动。
cues: where and when you experienced it
what you saw or did there
p2.explain: and explain what made it memorable.

p3: Why is it important to preserve historic buildings?
为什么保护历史建筑很重要？
How can tourism benefit local communities?
旅游如何为当地社区带来好处？
Do you think globalisation makes cultures more similar?
你认为全球化会使文化变得更相似吗？

focus: 串联熟悉话题，减少模板感
p1: Which part of your daily routine would you most like to change?
你最想改变日常作息的哪一部分？
What is something new you would like to learn?
你想学什么新东西？
Where would you like to spend more time in the future?
你将来希望在什么地方多待一些时间？

p2.title: Describe a change you made that improved your daily life.
p2.zh: 描述一个改善了你日常生活的改变。
cues: why you decided to make it
p2.explain: and explain what difference it has made to your life.

p3: Why are some people more willing to accept change than others?
为什么有些人比其他人更愿意接受改变？
How should governments balance short-term needs with long-term goals?
政府应如何平衡短期需求与长期目标？
Can technology solve most of the problems facing society?
科技能解决社会面临的大部分问题吗？
